# Community Conduct

Holdfast should be a place where people can contribute without having to navigate hostility, harassment, or status games.

When participating in issues, pull requests, reviews, or other project spaces:

- critique code and ideas, not people
- assume good intent until there is a reason not to
- be specific when something is wrong or unsafe
- keep disagreements focused on the work
- do not harass, threaten, dox, or target contributors
- do not post private guild/member information without permission
- do not use the project to promote hate or discrimination

Maintainers may edit, hide, or remove contributions that violate these expectations and may restrict participation when needed to protect the project or its contributors.

This is a game-community project. Competence and directness are welcome; cruelty and drama are not requirements for either.
